Carousel1.intro: Part of the Sustainable Energy Digital Intelligence Platform
Carousel1.title: Energy for Development
Carousel1.list: <item>The <bold> Sustainable Energy Academy</bold> - Dive into thought leadership, data visualization, and over 40 hours of expert-led content across 8 modules exploring the Energy for Development pathway</item><item><bold>Energy AI and Knowledge Graph</bold>  - Leverage the power of AI and interconnected data to uncover insights, drive smarter decisions, and accelerate sustainable energy solutions.</item><item><bold>Geospatial Data</bold> - Access spatial data to analyze energy access, identify equity gaps, and pinpoint opportunities for targeted action—right at your fingertips.</item>

Carousel2.intro: FOCUS AREA OF THE SUSTAINABLE ENERGY ACADEMY
Carousel2.title: Energy for Development
Carousel2.list: <item><bold>Close the gap in energy access</bold> so that marginalized people and communities gain access to sustainable, clean, energy and the dignity and opportunities it brings.</item><item><bold>Accelerate energy transition</bold> through system changes that support a green recovery and improve efficiency by bringing together the best ideas from government, private sector, finance, digital, and civil society.</item><item><bold>Catalyze energy finance</bold> by working with the public sector and global, regional, and local financial ecosystems to scale up public and private investments. </item>

Invitation.body: Welcome to the <bold>Sustainable Energy Digital Intelligence Platform</bold>, an innovative tool for driving system transformation through data-driven and integrated strategies to scale progress towards an inclusive and just sustainable energy transition.

ModulesFeature.title: Explore the Academy digital learning platform with 8 interactive e-modules
ModulesFeature.body: Dive into more than 40 hours of expert-written content and thought leadership. Discover 80 infographics and 60 data visualizations that bring energy trends to life. KnowledgeGraphPage.mobileInfoText: Leverage AI and knowledge graphs to explore sustainable energy transition strategy and insights from a custom database of energy publications and policies.
defaultIdeas: How can better just transition unlock inclusive energy systems that support health-related development in Sub-Saharan Africa?
How is Sub-Saharan Africa leveraging governance to expand renewable energy access for vulnerable communities in the education domain?
Which cross-sector partnerships could enhance governance and strengthen sustainable energy outcomes in Eastern Europe, particularly for gender equality?
How is Middle East and North Africa leveraging capacity building to expand renewable energy access for vulnerable communities in the climate adaptation domain?
What role does governance play in advancing sustainable energy in the energy access sector across Middle East and North Africa?
How is Latin America and the Caribbean leveraging just transition to expand renewable energy access for vulnerable communities in the climate adaptation domain?
Which cross-sector partnerships could enhance governance and strengthen sustainable energy outcomes in Global North vs Global South, particularly for education?
What are the political and economic trade-offs of scaling sustainable energy in the transport sector of Central Asia with current innovation frameworks?
What lessons can Central Asia teach the world about just transition-based solutions for clean energy in energy access?
Analyze the intersection of gender equality, just transition, and energy justice in the context of Sub-Saharan Africa's development priorities.
Explore opportunities for accelerating the energy transition in Pacific Islands' transport sector by investing in technology.
Explore opportunities for accelerating the energy transition in Small Island Developing States’s transport sector by investing in governance.
What role does infrastructure play in advancing sustainable energy in the energy access sector across Eastern Europe?
Evaluate the effectiveness of governance-driven approaches to integrating clean energy into energy access systems in Small Island Developing States.
What are the political and economic trade-offs of scaling sustainable energy in the finance sector of Southeast Asia with current data frameworks?
How is South Asia leveraging infrastructure to expand renewable energy access for vulnerable communities in the health domain?
Analyze the intersection of climate adaptation, infrastructure, and energy justice in the context of development priorities in the Asia-Pacific region.
What role does governance play in advancing sustainable energy in the transport sector across Middle East and North Africa?
How is Latin America and the Caribbean leveraging just transition to expand renewable energy access for vulnerable communities in the transport domain?
How is Middle East and North Africa leveraging innovation to expand renewable energy access for vulnerable communities in the transport domain?
Explore opportunities for accelerating the energy transition in Global North vs Global South's climate adaptation sector by investing in policy.
Evaluate the effectiveness of governance-driven approaches to integrating clean energy into industry systems in South Asia.
What lessons can Pacific Islands teach the world about policy-based solutions for clean energy in energy access?
Evaluate the effectiveness of governance-driven approaches to integrating clean energy into health systems in South Asia.
Analyze the intersection of agriculture, just transition, and energy justice in the context of Pacific Islands's development priorities.
Analyze the intersection of education, governance, and energy justice in the context of Latin America and the Caribbean development priorities.
What role does infrastructure play in advancing sustainable energy in the energy access sector across Small Island Developing States?
What lessons can Small Island Developing States teach the world about just transition-based solutions for clean energy in health?
How is Small Island Developing States leveraging governance to expand renewable energy access for vulnerable communities in the education domain?
What is the socio-economic and environmental impact of the rising demand for critical minerals on Indigenous communities?
How can we enhance energy security through diversified energy sources while ensuring affordability and reliability for underserved communities?
What strategies or policies can mitigate geopolitical risks affecting energy supply chains and global energy security?
Insights into innovative technological solutions or practices that enhance energy storage and reduce vulnerability to supply disruptions?
What are the human security implications of energy poverty and how can these be addressed through sustainable energy initiatives?
How do energy-related policies impact displacement patterns and migration, particularly in regions prone to energy shortages or environmental degradation?
How are feed-in-tariffs determined, and can I negotiate a tariff as an independent power producer?

Who are the main providers of concessional and blended finance to renewable energy projects, and what kinds of instruments do they provide? How would a project developer engage with them to secure financial support?

As a minigrid operator, what are the best ways to ensure that average revenue per user is high enough to meet costs and make me money? Are there ways I can better structure my business to ensure revenue is high enough to offset costs?

How should I approach deciding if my energy service business should leverage with debt or raise equity instead? What are the tradeoffs in the specific context of an energy business? (this could be adapted to any kind of business model in the energy space: SHS, e-mobility, data service, minigrid, IPP, etc.)
What is IRR, and why is it important to an energy business? How do investors deal with or think about IRR?

Explore publications and datasets to identify community-led initiatives addressing energy access challenges. Provide information on the effectiveness of such initiatives, key factors contributing to their success, and any replicable models for empowering communities in ensuring sustainable energy access.

Gather insights from publications and datasets on strategies and interventions to address energy poverty in urban areas. Explore the role of smart technologies, urban planning, and community engagement in ensuring equitable access to sustainable energy sources.
How can innovative financial instruments support the LAC region to finance the energy transition?
What are the current trends in renewable energy investment in developing countries?
What is the annual capacity addition of renewable energy needed to achieve the targets set in the Paris Agreement?
How is the increasing demand for renewable energy technology correlated with the demand for critical minerals?
What are the best practices in incorporating community engagement and participation in energy policy formulation to ensure social inclusivity and equity?
Explain the concept of decentralized energy systems and how they differ from traditional centralized models.
Explore the role of microgrids in enhancing the efficiency and reliability of decentralized energy systems.
What is the potential roles and risks for AI to advance sustainable energy transitions?
